notes.order: objects are in ld64 link order (N_OSO order == __text layout order in every module): loose objects in Xcode build-phase order, then archives in link-line order, each archive's pulled members in archive order. Xcode build-phase order = sources sorted by path relative to project_dir, compared uppercased; game client/server use three such sorted runs.
notes.archives: an archive lists only members some module pulled; prebuilt archives built without -g (libpng, libjpeg compiled as C++, protobuf, zlib) leave no N_OSO at all
notes.source: 'source' is the path in our tree (null if absent); 'retail_source' is Valve's path relative to build/src; status is exact|case|moved|missing relative to our tree
notes.defines: layered hints: xcconfig (SDK devtools/*.xcconfig) + vpc (evaluated for OSXALL/OSX32/POSIX Release) + platform_files selected by retail. NO_MALLOC_OVERRIDE is confirmed by the binaries: no memoverride object anywhere, malloc from libSystem, no g_pMemAlloc.
notes.toolchain: replay.dylib (2024) carries lib/clang/6.0/include line info (Apple LLVM 6.0, Xcode 6); hl2mp (2014) carries lib/clang/5.1; SDK 10.9 libstdc++ 4.2.1 headers; LC_VERSION_MIN 10.6. release.xcconfig adds -funswitch-loops.
